hypotheses: Current evidence is more consistent with near-term pullback or failed-transition risk than with confirmed broad altcoin rotation.
The sequence may represent a pause or local deterioration rather than a confirmed distribution regime because ETH/BTC persistence remains positive and the supplied evidence is shadow/proxy-only.

A healthy parabolic-continuation interpretation cannot be ruled out solely from sentiment or breadth weakness; persistent leadership and liquidity deterioration would be needed to distinguish it from a temporary reset.
